feedback:
The portal felt cluttered and the "Your info" wrapper made it
hard to find anything.
suggested_fix:
Split Your info into top-level Appointments / Care instructions
/ Forms and records / Payment method sections. Surface
Email <studio> in the header.

feedback: Care instructions were collapsed by default; clients miss them.
suggested_fix: Render Care instructions open by default via <details open>.

feedback: Signed forms looked clickable but had no destination. Confusing.
suggested_fix:
Rename to "Completed forms"; use a quiet divider list instead
of bordered cards. Add a footnote acknowledging that a
viewable copy is coming soon.

feedback: I don't know how to add a card. It should give you instructions.
suggested_fix:
Surface a "Card authorization needed before adding a card"
placeholder with a deep-link to the signing form. Mirror the
four states on the practitioner profile card.

feedback: Confirmation email said "11 to 12" instead of "11 AM to 12 PM".
suggested_fix:
Switch every client-facing email template to localTimeString12h
(keep practitioner calendar / dashboard on 24h).

feedback:
All of the client's booked appointments should show up under
their client profile. Right now I can only do that via calendar.
suggested_fix:
Add an Appointments timeline on the Sessions tab with
Upcoming / Needs charting / Charted / Cancelled / No-show
groups.

feedback:
All appointments are a session. From a client's profile or
from the calendar, I should be able to log the session and
chart.
suggested_fix:
Add sessions.appointment_id FK and surface Chart session
affordances from both the client profile timeline and the
calendar appointment detail.

feedback:
Editable appointment prep / before-treatment instructions per
service.
suggested_fix:
Make services.pre_care_instructions editable per-service from
Settings without code change.

feedback: Photo consent customization (different wording per studio).
suggested_fix:
Allow the owner to edit the photo_consent template body from
Settings → Consent forms.

feedback: Editable consent / policy / intake template bodies from the UI.
suggested_fix:
Intake builder + consent editor surfaces. Large scope; defer
until pilot stabilizes.

feedback: Percentage / time-window based cancellation fee model.
suggested_fix:
Today only a flat late_cancel_fee_cents / no_show_fee_cents
exists. Future: per-hour-window or percentage of service
price.

feedback:
A practitioner notifications feed (silent failures, give-up
SMS, manual fee charge results) visible inside Hone.
suggested_fix:
Surface the ops_alerts table (PR #153) inside the app for
owner-only viewing. ops_alerts already records redacted
failure rows.

feedback:
A way to actually view a signed form from the portal
(Completed forms list).
suggested_fix:
Build a signed-form viewer reading the template snapshot +
signature row. Future PR; PR #159 set the honest expectation
in copy.

feedback: Past appointments visible on the portal (not just upcoming).
suggested_fix:
Add a portal-side past-appointment read. Deferred from PR
#159 to keep that PR layout-only.

feedback: Email Chloe button should be at the top of the portal.
suggested_fix:
Move the contact-the-studio action into the header next to
Sign out.
